_comment: IR-cut PIN ORDER IS POLARITY. The two ircut pins are an H-bridge: ric drives one high and the other low for 100ms, then releases both. Swapped, every switch drives the filter the wrong way and day mode runs with the filter parked out -- IR floods the sensor and daylight comes back with a purple cast. Board-verified in this order on 2026-07-27. If a variant shows that cast in daylight, swap these two rather than reaching for the white balance. ir850 is the only LED switched; ir940 defaults off. These are measured on hardware, not read off a schematic.
